secondary_qualifier: Exact scoped no-go for the coefficient-free dagger/chiral equal-weight completion
exact_theorem: Let J be the source-native Lorentz Hodge operator on internal bivectors, J^2=-I, and P_plus=(I-iJ)/2, P_minus=(I+iJ)/2. Dagger interchanges P_plus and P_minus. The two chiral Palatini insertions are J P_plus and J P_minus, and their coefficient-free equal-weight real completion is J(P_plus+P_minus)=J, exactly the insertion already present in the real Palatini action. Their independent real combination is the Holst insertion -i(JP_plus-JP_minus)=I. A general dagger-real pair is a J-b I and therefore contains an undetermined real relative coefficient b/a unless another typed source law selects it.

Equal chiral weights return the old Hessian; unequal weights amount to choosing a new Holst/Immirzi-type relative coefficient not fixed by the present source laws.

counter_intuition.falsifier: A source-derived nonzero Palatini/Holst relative phase or an inequivalent off-diagonal chiral pairing fixed independently of the target rank.
